prompt: Write an inequality for "$x$ is more than $5$".
hint: "More than" compares two amounts. Decide which symbol opens toward the larger amount.

hints.text: "More than" compares two amounts. Decide which symbol opens toward the larger amount.
$x$ is the bigger quantity, so the open side of the symbol faces $x$. Write $x$, the symbol, then $5$.
"More than" means greater than, so the inequality is $x>5$.

explanation: "$x$ is more than $5$" says that $x$ is the larger of the two amounts.
"More than" matches the greater-than symbol $>$, and $5$ itself is not included.
Writing it in the same order as the sentence gives $x > 5$.
